Messages.Author: Piotr Wyskok
Messages.Body:
Hello %).
Let's assume that there's an action at +1 stealth. A minion blocking this
action gets +1 intercept (somehow), but the acting minion gets +1 more
stealth and he manages to get through the blocking minion.
The tricky part is [for me at least %)] that there's another minion untapped
that can block this action. Does stealth bonus (+2 at the moment) still
count for this action? Or if another minion blocks the acting minion has to
put up his stealths once more?
Thanx in advance.
dIABEU

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Piotr Wyskok wrote:



Modifications to stealth apply for the whole action.
